decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk system draws directly on the firm's office furniture know-how, and demand for flexible workplaces is growing, so the firm can keep interpreting results and refining it in-house.
The chair family sits at the core of the firm's craftsmanship and design knowledge, which lets it absorb customer feedback and update the line instead of withdrawing it.
Floor cushions made from carpets use the firm's material and upholstery expertise, but as a niche accessory line after several years they face a moderate risk of being pruned.
The high standing table closely matches the firm's existing conference tables, so it is cheap to maintain and fits the trend toward adaptable offices.
The rug collection is distant from the firm's core knowledge, but its flagship role and the designer collaborations behind it have given the firm time to build the know-how to manage it.
